analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Normalize xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg at the nil boundary, preserve the abstract list resource, and discharge the nil/non-nil pure branch.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove return_wit_1 by choosing its left disjunct, excluding nodes_general=nil from first<>head and the nil xizi_dllseg equations, and closing xizi_dll with the current endpoints. Prove return_wit_2 by choosing its right disjunct, substituting first=head, and excluding a cons list via the segment node<>stop guard. Prove the derive witness with nodes_general=nil and derivable1_wand_sepcon_adjoint, eliminating the impossible non-nil general result and preserving the nil xizi_dll resource into the weak result.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The abstract list is unchanged by empty(). The pointer comparison separates exactly the two constructors of the segment predicate: first different from the sentinel forces a nonempty logical list, while first equal to the sentinel forces nil. The weak nil-case contract is a direct specialization of the general contract at nodes=nil; its general nil postcondition entails the weak postcondition under the separating wand.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: One bounded group minimizes worker spawning while keeping all three closely related empty-list obligations and their common predicate context together; 3 witnesses is below max_witnesses_per_group=12.
